intro.background: 教玩具客户类型：幼儿园/托育连锁、幼教集团、海外经销商、工程承包商、房地产配套。开发渠道：LinkedIn、Alibaba、展会（GESS Dubai、育蕴）、Google搜索。开发信要短、要专业、不要群发感。
intro.desc: 掌握教玩具客户开发的英语表达。

oneLiner.en: The best teaching toy customers are not one-off buyers — they are chains, distributors and developers who buy every year.
oneLiner.cn: 最好的教玩具客户不是一次性买家——而是每年都买的连锁、经销商和开发商。

vocab.ex: We sent a cold email to 50 kindergartens.
vocab.exCn: 我们给50家幼儿园发了开发信。

vocab.ex: We are looking for distributors in Europe.
Kindergarten chains are our best clients.
vocab.exCn: 幼儿园连锁是我们最好的客户。

vocab.ex: We specialize in early childhood education spaces.
vocab.exCn: 我们专注幼儿教育空间。
请看我们的项目案例集。

vocab.ex: We have a case study in Dubai.

vocab.exCn: 我们可以提供参考客户。

vocab.ex: We pitched to a German chain last week.
vocab.exCn: 上周我们向德国连锁提案。

mistakes.wrong: We sell cheap furniture. Buy from us.
mistakes.right: We are a Wenzhou-based manufacturer specializing in kindergarten furniture and playground equipment, with projects in 50+ countries.
mistakes.cn: 错误：群发垃圾邮件。要专业、有案例、有定位。

basic.en: We are a manufacturer in Wenzhou.

advanced.en: We are a Wenzhou-based manufacturer specializing in turnkey kindergarten projects — furniture, functional rooms and outdoor playgrounds — with completed projects in over 50 countries.
advanced.cn: 我们是温州厂家，专注整园交钥匙项目——家具、功能教室、户外游乐——50多个国家有完工项目。
advanced.from: We are a manufacturer in Wenzhou.

advanced.en: We are currently looking for exclusive distributors in Europe. We offer OEM/ODM support, FSC-certified materials, EN1176-compliant equipment, and competitive margins.
advanced.cn: 我们正在寻找欧洲独家经销商。提供OEM/ODM支持、FSC认证材料、EN1176合规设备、有竞争力的利润。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Thanks for connecting. What do you do?

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Thank you! We are a Wenzhou-based manufacturer specializing in kindergarten furniture and outdoor playgrounds. We just completed a project in Riyadh.
lines.cn: 谢谢！我们是温州厂家，专注幼儿园家具和户外游乐。刚完成利雅得一个项目。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Interesting. We are a distributor in Germany.
lines.cn: 有意思。我们是德国经销商。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Wonderful. We are looking for partners in Germany. Could I send you our portfolio and schedule a 15-minute call next week?
lines.cn: 太好了。我们正在找德国合作伙伴。我能发您案例集，下周约15分钟电话吗？

fillBlank.q: We are looking for ____ in Europe.

scenario.q: Write a short LinkedIn intro message to a German kindergarten buyer.
scenario.modelAnswer: Hi [Name], thanks for connecting. We are a Wenzhou-based manufacturer specializing in kindergarten furniture and playground equipment, with projects in 50+ countries. Noticed your work with KitaGroup — would love to share our portfolio of European projects. Happy to schedule a quick call if useful.
scenario.cn: [名字]你好，谢谢通过。我们是温州厂家，专注幼儿园家具和游乐设备，50多国项目。注意到您在KitaGroup的工作——很想分享我们的欧洲项目案例集。如果方便可以约个短电话。

culture.title: 开发信的3秒法则
culture.content: 海外客户每天收几十封开发信，3秒内没兴趣就删。你的邮件：第一行说你是谁+做什么，第二行说你和他的关联，第三行给一个具体动作（发案例/约电话）。不要长篇大论。

rounds.ai: Thanks for connecting. What do you do?
rounds.hint: 温州厂家+整园项目+案例。

rounds.ai: We are a distributor in Germany.
Could you send us your catalog?
